Messages.Author: kombainas
Messages.Body:
I have two slots in !Malk DEM OBF AUS based !malk deck. The deck has (really) good poolgain, but is vulnerable to combat, BUT can fetch Secure Haven faster and pull off bleeds anywhere on the table. What I need is to fill those two slots with permableed to compensate for playing with a single vampire. After done with the rusher, the vamp can perish under Archon Investigation, I can afford that.

I was filling those two slots with Enchanted Marionette and Pulse of the Canaille, but lately I have seen Dive Into The Madness advocated as a good permableed, so I thought, whether my choices were sub-optimal? Do you have other suggestions how to make a single vamp a mean bleed machine in otherwise certain vamp-unfocused deck?

Enchanted Marionette

[Equipment]
[Malkavian antitribu]
[3 Pool]

Unique equipment.
The Malkavian antitribu with this equipment gets +1 bleed and +1 stealth when bleeding.

Pulse of the Canaille

[Action]
[Auspex]
[3 Blood]

+1 stealth action.
[aus] For the remainder of this turn, you may look at all Methuselahs' hands.
[AUS] Put this card on the acting vampire. The vampire with this card gets +2 bleed. A vampire can have only one Pulse of the Canaille.

Sabbat. If this vampire's bleed is successful, he laughs manicly and untaps.

Messages.Author: extrala
Messages.Body:
I think I would choose none of the above.
* Enchanted Marionette is just too expensive
* Pulse of Canaille looks good in the first place, but it costs three blood and you need a vampire with AUS. The same vampire that most likely needs his blood for playing Telepathic Misdirection.

If you actually want to play Permableed in !Malk bleed deck, I would just add one copy of Tasha Morgan and J.S. Simmons, Esq. instead. It's cheap and it's not interfering with the Kindred Spirits bleed action like Camera Phone, Codex of Ednic Groundskeeper, etc..

Messages.Author: kombainas
Messages.Body:
Thanks! I'd like to know of viable options in general, so I did not get specific with my deck.

Maybe something more, for 2+ bleed/stealt? It is hard to justify action to equip +1 stealth/+1 bleed when half of crypt has inbuilt +1 stealth/+1 bleed as it is. Even if they hadn't, +1 permableed instead of bleed +3 with DEM KS+EoC for 1 poolgain would break even 4 turns after equiping. Which is 20 pool damage in a perfect world. Which is more than enough to oust a rush deck. +2 bleed bleed on the other hand means breaking even 2 turns after equiping. 3 turns = 12 pool damage, which is somewhat not enough for the 1st oust, hence it would be worth to get +2 permableed.

On the other hand, if I replaced EoC with Confusion, +1 permableed would sound just as well, since you would get your action-worth in 3rd turn after eq. action and at 12 poold damage equivalent. Wee!

Messages.Author: brandonsantacruz
Messages.Body:
Rather than focus on picking the best mid to high-capacity vampires to counter combat, I would suggest just bringing out more small guys. If you have several vampires it isn't as big of a deal if one or even two go down to rush. With the spare actions you can rescue them, they can hunt and then they are a fully functional DEM/dem bleeder. Include Giant's Blood and Coven to keep your blood supply up.

Just by having more minions you have more permanent bleed, by the way, and in a way that isn't as vulnerable to Archon Investigation or bleed bounce.

This deck is actually designed to withstand combat-heavy metagame without reducing it effectiveness. I have turbine (InfoH+Zhilla+Dreams) and minion tap(should be villein)+low blood cost cards (only telepathic misdirection and elder impersonation cost blood) so I can safely leave 1-3 blood on a vamp and if they go to torpor, I Golconda them. Healthy pool + 8+caps brought out in a single turn works magic. Usual problem is that metagame rush is pretty efficient at getting in combat and more often than not they can send more than 1 minion into torpor and I find myself influencing a vamp and losing it before my turn comes. Therefore I need a reliable way to keep constant pressure even with a single vamp and backoust as necessary

I did try to somewhat weenify the deck, but it turned out slower, less effective at ousting and even more vulnerable in my metagame.

Messages.Author: Chaitan
Messages.Body:
You have built a deck that remove vampires using golconda once they have filled their purpose or sent to torpor.

I think you should build your entire deck with this in mind, the next step is just to optimize the card flow.

* Remove Minion Tap in favor of Villein. This is probably the single best change you can do.

* Replace Bitter and Sweet Story, The with Anthelios. This way you can reduce the number of golconda you must have and still be able to use it whenever you want.

* Skip all permanents (such as Pulse of the Canaille, Enchanted Marionette). They will be gone when removed by Golconda.

* Into Thin Air should IMHO always be replaced with Lost in Crowds. The drawback is too heavy.

* Marked Path is such a bad card. Replace with more Lost.

* Abandoning the Flesh. No.

* Wake with evenings Freshness is clearly inferior to Eyes of Argus in this deck.

* Add one Coma. It is a card that should never be played but always to be feared. You should act as if you always have a Coma in your hand but never actually do.

* Swallowed by the Night is such an awesome stealth card in high combat meta. If you didn't go for the Golconda angle I'd suggest you use ton of it in combination with Disgused+Ivory Bow and other fun weapons.

* If you are playing in intercept heavy meta. Replace some of the Eyes of Chaos with Confusion. It will reduce your bleed potential but it's better with a small bleed than no bleed.

Messages.Author: kombainas
Messages.Body:
I would disagree about Jason. He burns blood to get bleed, which this decks cannot afford. Louhi has 3 votes in otherwise voteless (bar another bishop) deck and her ability is the only one defensive and especially effective against certain rushes. Much better spent 1 blood cost, imho. I was thinking of Lutz though, but then couldn't find justification to spend 3 more transfers for an additional +1 bleed and an abbility I would never trigger myself.

Yes, it is either wall or nothing currently in my metagame, and loads of bleed redirects. 1 stealth card per action card ratio turned out to be ok. But I did replace permableed with a little more bleed, and changed EoC: confusion ratio to 2:1.

Sibyl's Tongues are for fetching Secure Haven and/or Parthenon early. Having 2 to 8 is always good, and it is hard to underestimate its usefulness against Rush or Master hand jam. Notice that cheap, but otherwise useless Bloodfeud can play them (first 3 at least) and back them with stealth, thus making him pretty useful and even finding that Secure Haven before any of the big guys hit the table

Secure Haven is way of life
